changelog:
• Windows Store & Desktop Packaging Fix: Fixed missing yt-dlp.exe ENOENT error by bundling standalone binaries directly and adding automatic self-healing runtime fallback
• Blazing Fast Audio Downloads: Ultra-fast multi-threaded MP3 downloading with concurrent fragment extraction
• Stream Resolution Reliability: Direct streaming and playback fixed for all online tracks
• Clean Production Library: Purged non-functional sample tracks for a pristine experience
• Seamless Over-The-Air Online Updates: Automatic silent updates without manual reinstall
